name: Morishita Michiru
source:
Michiru is a first year female student and Isara's classmate. She is a newcomer who joined Shokken just before the election.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi_to_Senkyo_to_Chocolate]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler]She has an unique form of synesthesia as she sees colors in people and helps determine if the person is good or not.[/spoiler]
